title: Release prep: security review
description: Before going public: secrets/personal data scan of tree AND full git history, cargo audit/deny for vulnerable deps, licence check of third-party sample files and assets, launcher update path (HTTPS, integrity of downloaded MSI), file parsing robustness (.pub parser panics/OOM on hostile files), installer/registry, unsafe code.

title: Setup.exe: desktop shortcut choices + Launch button
description: Owner expected the installer to ask about desktop shortcuts for KernPage and KernPage Launcher, and to open the app at the end. Add two checkboxes to the Setup.exe (Burn WixStdBA) page, wire them to MSI properties, keep the choice across launcher MSI updates; success page Launch button (LaunchTarget, added).

title: KernPage Launcher + auto-updater (ArtCraft-style)
description:
Separate launcher app (user decision 2026-11-12): Start-menu/desktop shortcut opens the launcher; double-clicking a .pub still opens KernPage directly, and KernPage itself behaves like Publisher. Own clean style (layout/behaviour like ArtCraft Launcher, KernPage colours, light/dark/match system; no ArtCraft branding or code).
Launcher window: KernPage card with installed version -> latest version, UPDATE AVAILABLE badge, download size, last updated, Open KernPage, Update to X, ... menu (what's new, GitHub, reinstall/older version); Open file...; Recent files list (shared with KernPage's recent list); refresh button; footer 'Checked just now - using GitHub'.
Updates: query GitHub Releases latest for jmitchell238/kernpage; Windows toast; 'X is available' dialog with What's new / Later / Update and restart; download MSI asset with progress, verify SHA-256 checksums asset, run msiexec passive with verbose log in %LOCALAPPDATA%\KernPage\logs, relaunch. Launcher self-update via helper exe.
Settings: language; check for updates (automatically/manually); auto download and install; notify on update; include pre-releases; version picker (roll back); appearance match system/dark/light; keep running in tray when closed; start at login; community links (GitHub issues/discussions); Quit launcher; Done.
Packaging: add launcher exe + shortcut to the MSI; .pub association stays on kernpage.exe.
Testable now against a local fake release feed; goes live only with the first public release (no releases until 1.0).

title: Publisher 2021 look: deviations after UI steps 1-2
description: Logged per match-Publisher rule. (1) Ribbon does not shrink/collapse groups when the window is narrow: Page Design clips Page Background at 1600px; 2021 scales galleries/groups down. (2) Placeholder drop-downs and dialog launchers draw but open nothing; Schemes gallery static with invented swatches. (3) Find, Bullets, Numbering split vs drop-down unconfirmed. (4) Undo/Redo split menus show only the top step (2021 lists history). (5) No Touch/Mouse Mode or Customize QAT buttons. (6) Our font is wider than Segoe UI so groups are wider. (7) Page indicator and zoom % are labels, not buttons (no Go To Page / Zoom dialogs). (8) Pages pane: x button instead of collapse triangle, 138px wide vs 175px, no Section header. (9) Several commands disabled that 2021 enables (Mailings, Review). (10) Backstage, Print and Export still 2010 style. (11) No contextual tabs yet (Shape Format, Text Box, Picture Format, Table Design/Layout).

title: Cell text wraps narrower than Publisher (table-2x2-grown: 5 lines vs 4)
description: Found in pw-cok2 (779c358): our wrap width/metrics for table cells is slightly narrower than Publisher's, so an edited cell grows taller than Publisher would. Calibrate cell text width (margins) or font metrics from the spec/samples.
notes: Investigated 2026-11-25. Calibri IS resolved (C:\Windows\Fonts\calibri.ttf), so not a missing-font issue. Cell: col 150 pt, margins 2.88 each (36576 EMU) -> usable 144.24 pt; Calibri 10 pt, text 539.9 pt wide unkerned (536.6 with kern table). Greedy wrap of the sample text gives 4 lines only for width >= 150.5 pt (unkerned). Line 4 'seventeen eighteen nineteen twenty.' = 152.2 pt (149.7 without the period); 'eight..twelve thirteen' = 150.4. So at 144.24 pt NO metric tweak under ~4% yields 4 lines; kerning alone (3.4 pt total) is not enough either. Candidates, each fits only with the full 150 pt column: (a) Publisher does not subtract left/right cell margins from wrap width + kerns; (b) full width + trailing period hangs. One sample cannot tell them apart; vertical margins are confirmed (61.55 = 55.78 + 2 x 2.88). Need a second Publisher sample (wrapped cell with different col width/margins, ideally with COM line positions) before changing the wrap width. No code change committed.

title: Bullets UI: confirm guessed wording and values with owner
description: From pw-cibs step 3. Guessed: Separator list entries (bare marks . ) ] : () [] -- plus None; ninth entry U+3001), last three Format entries (One, Two, Three / First, Second, Third / 01, 02, 03), spinner steps (Size 1 pt, Indent 0.1in), indent buttons step 0.25in, main Bullets/Numbering buttons toggle the default, Bullet Character font list. Wingdings/Webdings grids mostly show dots (no full mapping). Also check that canvas fonts draw diamond/arrow/open-diamond bullets.
notes: Also (pw-df5): confirm Ctrl+= / Ctrl+Shift+= are Publisher's subscript/superscript shortcuts; canvas super/sub uses top/bottom alignment at 0.65x, not the exact 0.47/0.145 baseline offsets used in PDF.

title: List keyboard behaviour: Tab/Shift+Tab, Enter on empty item, Backspace at start
description: Deferred by the owner during pw-cibs. Assumed Publisher behaviour (BULLETS.md section 7): Enter on an empty list item ends the list, Backspace at the start removes the bullet first, Tab/Shift+Tab change the indent. Needs confirming before building.

title: Canvas list gaps: linked-frame numbering, justified first line, wide labels
description: From pw-cibs step 2. (1) Canvas numbers each linked frame on its own, so a numbered list that continues into the next frame restarts at 1 (PDF is correct). (2) The first line of a justified list paragraph is drawn left-aligned on the canvas. (3) When a label is wider than the hanging indent, Publisher's behaviour hasn't been measured; we jump to the next 36 pt tab stop (UNCONFIRMED in pub_format::list::line_starts).

title: Launcher Settings: stale 'next step' note, greyed Version box, unlabelled combo boxes

title: Ribbon combo boxes (font name/size etc.) have no accessible label
description: Found while building kittest tests: unlabelled combo boxes trip the AccessKit check. Screen readers can't name them. Give each a label (Font, Font Size, ...).

title: Page setup leftovers after the MVP
description: Left from MVP item 5 (commits e40b763..d2b1b91): other layout types in Page Setup (booklet, envelope, folded card, multiple per sheet, labels); Grid Guides and Baseline Guides tabs; Two-page master (mirrored margins, spec 4Q.6 not decoded); size changes that move groups/tables/pictures/rotated shapes off the page (writer refuses today); editor has no scratch area (off-page shapes stay put until saved); spin arrows not keyboard-focusable / no Up/Down stepping. Create New Page Size and More Preset Page Sizes are pw-4r3 and pw-00d.

title: Check interactive Insert > Pictures size in Publisher 2021 for large pictures
description: COM AddPicture keeps natural size even when the picture is bigger than the page (3000x2000 px -> 2250x1500 pt). Our editor shrinks it to fit the page. Check what Publisher 2021's own Insert > Pictures button does with a big photo and match it.

title: Launcher polish from the 3b-2 hand test
description:
Small follow-ups found while testing updates on an installed copy (2026-11-14):
1. Dashboard content (incl. the install banner) stops at 1180 px, so on a wide/maximised window it doesn't use the full width. User: not a big deal.
2. Error 1620 (damaged MSI) message says 'Windows put your current version back' - for 1620 nothing was changed at all; give 1619/1620 their own wording ('The update file is damaged...').
3. If the update helper is killed mid-install, msiexec still finishes (install works) but the launcher is not reopened and no result banner appears next start.
4. Not yet seen: background auto-install while the launcher sits hidden in the tray (does eframe keep getting frames?), and whether the Windows toast shows the name 'KernPage'.
